verdict.oneLineSummary: Gated by 6-12 week CASA security audit ($3k-$10k) for any Gmail content scopes.

twoClocks.worksInDev: ~1 hr (100 test users, tokens expire in 7 days)

cost: Setup free. Restricted-scope CASA security assessment is paid via a third-party lab ($3,000–$10,000).

capabilityCheck.question: Can you read and send email on the user's behalf?
capabilityCheck.detail: Gmail scopes allow reading and sending — no capability ceiling on the actions themselves. The wall is ACCESS: Gmail content scopes are 'restricted' and gated behind verification + CASA assessment before any non-test user can connect.

prerequisites: A verified domain in Google Search Console (required once you add a homepage or privacy policy URL)
A publicly accessible Privacy Policy URL

fields.name: Organization / Location
fields.note: Shows only 'No organization' on a personal Gmail — that's correct, not an error. Leave it.

steps.text: Configure the OAuth consent screen under 'Google Auth Platform → Branding'.

fields.name: App name / User support email / Developer contact
App logo
fields.note: LEAVE EMPTY. Uploading a logo immediately triggers brand verification, delaying your project by weeks.

fields.name: App home page / Privacy policy / Authorized domains
fields.note: Skip these while in Testing mode

steps.text: Set Audience to External and add yourself as a test user. Leave Publishing status on 'Testing'.

fields.name: Test users
fields.note: Without this, even you cannot log in (hard cap of 100 test accounts)

fields.name: Publish app
fields.note: DO NOT CLICK. Publishing starts the weeks-long verification pipeline.

steps.text: Add scopes under 'Data Access' (Notice Google renamed 'Scopes' to 'Data Access').

fields.name: Gmail scopes (gmail.readonly, gmail.send)
fields.note: Flags as 'restricted' → mandates verification + third-party CASA security assessment

steps.text: Create OAuth Client Credentials under 'Clients' (= credentials).

fields.name: Authorized redirect URIs
fields.note: Must match your code character-for-character including trailing slashes

blockers.issue: Scopes are hidden under a tab named 'Data Access' (not 'Scopes'); 'Organization' field looks mandatory but must be 'No organization' on personal Gmail.
blockers.workaround: Navigate directly to Data Access; select 'No organization' and proceed.

blockers.issue: Any Gmail content scope is 'restricted' — production access for any public user requires Google verification + a paid CASA security assessment (6–12 weeks, $3k–$10k).
blockers.workaround: Stay in Testing mode for internal prototypes, or use Composio Managed Auth to bypass your own CASA assessment.

composio.recommendation: Gmail is the single most painful DIY OAuth path. Using Composio's managed Gmail app bypasses the 60-day CASA security review and thousands in audit costs.

evidence.claim: Configured the consent screen and saw the restricted-scope warning appear when adding a Gmail scope; confirmed Testing-mode 100-user cap on the Audience page.
evidence.label: TESTED

evidence.claim: Restricted-scope verification requires a CASA security assessment and commonly takes 6–12 weeks with third-party assessor costs.
evidence.label: SOURCED
